dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Irregular and non-falcate trailing edge due to a major structural notch; spline fit is disrupted by a deep, jagged excision approximately midway along the posterior margin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute and slightly rounded apex with a small pixel radius, forming the highest point of the remaining dorsal structure.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Gradual anterior slope of approximately 30 degrees relative to the longitudinal body axis, characterized by a smooth, continuous convex curve.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Wide base relative to height, with an approximate 2.8:1 ratio of maximum horizontal pixel width to maximum vertical pixel height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, jagged excision (notch) on the trailing edge of the dorsal fin. Multiple white punctate markings of varying sizes distributed across the dark epidermal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A faint horizontal linear crease or scar is visible near the base of the fin, extending from the anterior margin toward the posterior notch.
